claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole on June 15, 1869.
claims.excerpt: Thefirstfight betweep Tom Allen and Mike McCoole took place June 15, 1869.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole a second time on September 3, 1873.
claims.excerpt: and their second battle occurred on Sept. 3, 1873.

claims.statement: At the time of his 1873 fight with McCoole, Tom Allen kept a saloon on Washington Avenue between Fourth and Fifth streets, St. Louis.

notes: A short record of two fights, given as a reply to a reader's question. Both fight claims are recollections of dates.
